description: Add a link button to the page. Optionally schedule it (it shows only between startsAt and endsAt) or put it in the spotlight. Church platform links are recognised (Planning Center's Church Center, Pushpay, Tithe.ly, Subsplash, Breeze, Realm, YouVersion): leave out the title and they get a plain one, like "Give", "Join a group" or "Events". Planning Center and Pushpay giving links can also carry gift options (giving).

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

giving.description: Gift options, only for giving links on Planning Center (a churchcenter.com /giving link) and Pushpay (pushpay.com/g/…). They're written into the link, so the giving page opens with them filled in. Options left out stay as they are.

amount.description: A suggested amount, like 25 or 25.50. null removes it.

fund.description: Planning Center: the fund's name from its Church Center link (new-building in /giving/to/new-building). Pushpay: the fund's name or key. "" removes it.

recurring.description: Open the giving page set to a recurring gift (Pushpay: monthly). false removes it.

spotlight.description: Put it in the spotlight: shown first on the page, highlighted. Only one block has it; this takes it from any other.

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

title.description: The button's text. Needed, except for a recognised church platform link, which gets a plain default.

url.description: A web address (https://…), a bare domain, or an email address.

name: add_link
title: Add a link
